description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Weeravila New Town, Lunugamvehera D/S Division, Hambantota District  (25/0102)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations regarding specific land parcels. It involves declarations of title settlement for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act, contains detailed land parcel numbers, cadastral map references, and location details, and focuses entirely on land ownership matters (all parcels are registered to "The State"). This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and land settlement matters.
